name: Money Market Statistical Report Status Advice V 01
definition: The MoneyMarketStatisticalReportStatusAdvice message is sent by the relevant competent authority to the reporting agents to provide the status on the reported transactions.

StatusReportHeader.name: Status Report Header
StatusReportHeader.definition: Provides the status on the global report.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Provides the status on an individual transaction and the related reason if required.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
